title: Act 3's opening recap lists 'sit in it with a crown' as an ending path but never flags, anywhere in the journal, that the Vale side-quest crown (obtained ~150 turns earlier, in Act 1's Elder's House) is the very item that satisfies it — no 'this may matter later' marker the way other quest items get.
